ai_summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited has announced the commissioning of an additional 52.32 MW / 209.28 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) component for its FDRE Project in Rajasthan, with a Commercial Operation Date (COD) set for November 19, 2026. This significant milestone increases the cumulative commissioned BESS discharge capacity to 247.67 MW / 990.68 MWh, nearing the 300 MW / 1200 MWh project goal. The project has a secured Power Purchase Agreement with SJVN Limited, ensuring clear revenue generation potential from these operational assets.
